penalties.details: Assessment Order dated March 26, 2026 passed under Section 143(3) read with Section 144B of the tax Act, along with Notice of Demand dated March 26, 2026 issued under Section 156 of the Act, wherein there is a total tax demand including interest of Rs. 15,36,16,600/-
penalties.impact: Tax demand including interest of Rs. 15,36,16,600/- The Company is under the process of filing an appeal before the Higher Appellate Authorities, against the said order within the prescribed timelines. The Company believes that it has adequate factual and legal grounds to reasonably substantiate its position in the matter. Accordingly, the Company expects the demand to subside. As such, there is no impact on financial operations or other activities of the Company.

timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (standalone): revenue ₹420.18 Cr (+4.9% YoY), net profit ₹1.14 Cr (against a loss of ₹11.94 Cr a year earlier).
Prataap Snacks reported Q4 FY26 revenue of ₹420.2 crore and annual revenue of ₹1,725 crore, recommending a dividend of ₹0.50 per share.

Authum Investment & Infrastructure disclosed under SAST Regulation 31(4) that 4,60,000 Prataap Snacks shares (1.92% of capital) of its 44% promoter holding were encumbered by a margin pledge during FY26.
Prataap Snacks received stock exchanges' no-objection letters for the re-classification of six promoter group members to public.
